Map Name: Graystar
Map Creators: MonsieurStar, Evocal
Map Gamemode: Nebula DTM

Information:
Blue vs Lime (20 vs 20)
Small Rotation :)
Iron blocks and some diamond goodies
Many super fabulous secrets :P

This is my Debut map, so I genuinely hope you enjoy it!

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The aesthetics are not that great. Its mainly just stained clay and quartz. You used it nicely in some cases like the frontlines and the sides of the lanes but the castle does not look that good.

This could be a really cool map if you had it with a medieval palette. It wouldn't change gameplay but the aesthetics would be a lot better.

Going back to the castle I like how you did the part where its "breaking". I like that part and it was really nicely done.

As for gameplay it looks like there is not that much iron (or im just missing it) from the pictures. Even if its for small rotations there should still be a bit more iron on the map. Maybe hide it around or in the castle as it blends in with quartz nicely.

I like what you have done with the lighting.

I really like the map. It looks like it could play good but the stained clay just doesn't work that great with a build like this. The castle would look so much better if you done it with a medieval palette. Please consider changing the palette and decorating this a bit more with a medieval palette as it would look a lot better.
